description: Run one endpoint by the tool name that search_apis returned, with that endpoint's parameters, and get its data back as JSON (with source and licence attribution). Endpoints with free_tier "free" or "sample" cost nothing within the daily allowance (100 calls/day anonymously, 500 with a free key). Otherwise the result is a payment request: pay in USDC via x402 and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]. Invalid arguments are rejected before any charge, and failed upstream calls are never charged.

arguments.description: The endpoint's parameters as listed in search_apis results, e.g. {"postcode": "SW1A 1AA"}.

tool.description: Endpoint tool name from search_apis, e.g. "uk-postcodes__lookup" or "sanctions__screen".

name: call_api

outputSchema.description: The endpoint's JSON response. Proxied sources return {data, source{name, licence, attribution}}; first-party endpoints return their own documented object. List responses are wrapped as {result: [...]}.

title: Call a data API
